adjudication.rationale: In Jobs::PollFeed#execute the guard is a conjunction: `feed_polling_enabled? && feed_polling_url.present? && embed_by_username.present?`. In `spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb`, the examples "requires feed_polling_url" and "requires embed_by_username" only stub `SiteSetting.feed_polling_url`/`embed_by_username` to nil, but do not stub `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` to true. Since `config/site_settings.yml` sets `feed_polling_enabled: false` by default, `execute` will short-circuit on `feed_polling_enabled?` and never call `poll_feed` regardless of the other two checks, so those specs can pass even if the `feed_polling_url`/`embed_by_username` guards were removed.
